goal: Restrict proposer execution to an approved versioned text request and prevent unrelated or repeated execution evidence from influencing branch selection.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Bind the complete fixed-route request before credential access or sending, without workspace tools or profile execution.
Replay actual candidate, task, state, receipt and verdict bindings and count each execution only once.
Integrate explicit-model request preparation and candidate artifact recording through the CLI and workbench.
Pass the complete repository gate with reviewed capsule source identities.

outcome.summary: All 131 focused tests pass. Full verification passes typecheck/build and 326 tests, with seven skips and one expected capsule-integrity failure. Changed contracts require human-reviewed capsule refresh.

exception.reason: The spec, architecture and roadmap source digests differ from their reviewed capsule pins.
exception.next_action: Review the new request-approval and branch-proof contracts, authorize capsule refresh, then rerun the full local gate.

what_worked: The proposer no longer launches a workspace-enabled agent process.
Branch statistics revalidate their evidence rather than trusting stored provenance and score fields.
Negative controls cover request drift, transport limits, sensitive replies, candidate drift and duplicate execution credit.
what_failed: Full closure is blocked by source-pin drift in two capsules.
The initial plugin integration lacked the newly required explicit model; the tool contract and regression were updated.

calls.purpose: Verify proposer, transport, branch, receipt, CLI and workbench controls locally.

calls.name: pnpm-check
calls.purpose: Run the full local verification chain.

calls.purpose: Identify exact source-pin drift without bypassing review.

failures_and_inefficiencies.summary: Contract changes invalidate source-bound capsules until review.
failures_and_inefficiencies.suggested_action: Review the request boundary and branch proof migration before refreshing pins.

evidence.summary: Versioned fixed-route DeepSeek request, explicit model, exact request approval, no tool/profile/subprocess access, bounded transfer and privacy-safe output.
Versioned artifact/task/receipt evidence replay, deterministic execution identity, historical incomplete proof exclusion and conflicting reuse denial. Integrity is not independent attestation.
Six focused suites passed 131 tests. Mocked transport only; no provider request, profile mount, installation or candidate activation was performed.

Typecheck/build passed. Tests: 326 passed, seven skipped, one failed capsule test. Later chained gates did not run. Capsule checks identify spec source 0 and adapter-boundary sources 0 and 2 as changed. Diff whitespace checks passed.

notes: The user accepted implementation of the next boundary increment. Final contract/capsule review is pending. This task grants no model-call, activation, or publication authority.
